baselines.name: Official RFamLlama
baselines.license_note: Apache-2.0 code repository; verify the selected model-weight license.
baselines.fairness_note: Optional proposal/likelihood ablation only; do not label as a same-task IRES design baseline.

baselines.name: GenerRNA
baselines.license_note: Record the exact model-card revision and license.
baselines.fairness_note: Optional proposal/likelihood ablation only; do not label as a same-task IRES design baseline.

baselines.name: IRES-EA
baselines.license_note: Upstream code is GPL-3.0; record separate checkpoint and data terms.
baselines.fairness_note: Match seed, editable positions, edit limit, population and oracle-query budget; otherwise report as external.

baselines.name: IRES-DM released outputs
baselines.license_note: Upstream code is GPL-3.0; verify released-sequence and data terms.
baselines.fairness_note: Released outputs are an exact-task reference but are not data- or budget-matched.

baselines.name: IRES-DM same-protocol retraining
baselines.license_note: GPL-3.0-derived adapter/retraining; do not redistribute upstream weights or data without checking terms.
baselines.fairness_note: Required for a strict de novo claim; use the frozen shared split, training data and query/evaluation budget.

baselines.name: LM-likelihood-guided mutation
baselines.license_note: Method reimplementation; cite the original functional-mutation study.
baselines.fairness_note: Match the parent LM, edit limit, candidate count, and query budget.

baselines.name: Structure-only IRES mutation
baselines.license_note: Independent implementation of the published structure-identity, pairing and MFE rule.
baselines.fairness_note: Apply to the same mutation pool without a function score; report MFE and ensemble variants separately.

baselines.name: Score-only genetic algorithm
baselines.license_note: Standard genetic algorithm control; record implementation and package versions.
baselines.fairness_note: Primary paired control: identical initialization, operators and oracle calls to robust_full, with only the objective set changed.

baselines.name: Budget-matched random screening
baselines.license_note: Built as a project control; method precedent from PARADE.
baselines.fairness_note: Generate and score exactly the same number of candidates as every learned/search baseline.

baselines.name: NSGA-II
baselines.license_note: Use a pinned pymoo version or document an independent implementation.
baselines.fairness_note: Algorithm definition stays fixed across backbones and variants.

baselines.name: IRESbase reference
baselines.license_note: Record download date, database terms and assay provenance for every entry.
baselines.fairness_note: Distribution reference only; entries are not assumed to have equivalent evidence or assay context.

baselines.name: Local RFamLlama-style reproduction
baselines.license_note: Local checkpoint; do not redistribute until data/code provenance is audited.
baselines.fairness_note: Supplement only; not an original foundation-model contribution.
